GLOSSARY OF IMPORTANT FISH SPECIES OF INDIA
0. FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 14 March 1974, after the draft finalized by the Fish and Fisheries Products Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council. 0.2 With a view to facilitating uniform interpretation of various commercially important inland and marine fish species of India, this Indian Standard has been formulated. 0.3 It is intended that adoption of the Indian Standard glossary would facilitate the interstate and international trade in fresh and processed fish and avoid disputes arising from misinterpretation of various species of fish based on their common and local names. 0.4 This standard is based on the information received from Directorates of Fisheries of different states, the Zoological Survey of India, Calcutta and the Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute, Co&in. 1. SCOPE 1.1 This standard includes zoological names, common English names and local names of some commercially important fresh water and marine fish species of India. 1.1.1 This standard also includes some commercially important crustaceans. 2. ABBREVLATIONS 2.1 For the purpose of this standard, apply : Ben Guj Hin Kan Ma1 Mar Ory Sp. or Spp Tam Tel 3 the following abbreviations Bengali Gujarati Hindi Kanada Malayalam Marathi Oriya Species Tamil Telugu shall
